name: Asymmetric Determinant with Hidden Symmetry
description: We replace the explicit matrix with a highly asymmetric matrix whose determinant factors into (s_u - s_v)(s_u^2 + 3s_v^2 + 1). We specify that BOTH orientations of the link must have a non-zero determinant. A superficial reading might assume this implies a directed constraint graph or asymmetric configuration, breaking the symmetry assumptions of standard 3-coloring solvers. However, since the second factor is strictly positive, the condition mathematically reduces exactly to s_u != s_v, preserving the undirected 3-coloring structure perfectly.
